reason: My guests come back because they talk to me, Jasper, not to a machine. I already answer the Wi-Fi and parking questions myself on WhatsApp, and €120 a season is real money for something I do for free.
objection: A robot answering my guests takes away the personal touch that gets me good reviews, and if it says something wrong I am the one who looks bad.
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour host I trust used it a full summer and showed me guests still left good reviews and it saved them real hours, and my nephew could set it up for me.
